subject: prog-cont
title: PROG.CONT.------INFO.DY.
description: Second diagram on page 345 (PMBA-9), paired with (R)STF × SOC-RT above. Where the first diagram structurally diagrams how rock-and-roll's source-transfer reaches social-reality via the white-community transfer-cycle, this one names what progressional-continuance meets when information-dynamics is the working partner — the deeper question of how black popular music's continuance is converted by the receiving information-channel: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance — the form's actual forward motion) crossed with INFO-DY (information dynamics). PROG-CONT sits on the left with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs right to INFO-DY at center-right as partner-axis. TR (transformation) branches from the main line; TH-CONT (thrust continuance) at top-center branches from TR's line, CPS-P at left from TH-CONT's line, and (P)SG (point of idea completion: source initiation) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) from CPS-P's line. PRI-INFO (principle information) at upper-right branches from the main line and carries IST-F (isolated focus); SOC-RT-DT (social-reality dictates) branches from IST-F's line and LANG-DY (language dynamics) from SOC-RT-DT's line. Below the main line, TRS (transition, lowercase) branches from it, RE-ST (restructuralism) at lower-left from TRS's line, STF (source transfer) at the bottom from RE-ST's line, and TM (terminology—or terms of a definition) from STF's line.
